This gourmet Swiss chocolate bar makes a great gift for a friend or treat for yourself. Lindt chocolate is best stored in a cool, dry place to ensure highest quality and freshness.

results.description:
Now you can enjoy your favourite STARBUCKS café flavour in the comfort of your own home with STARBUCKS Almond & Oat Non Dairy Hazelnut Latte Coffee Enhancer (828 ml). Inspired by STARBUCKS Hazelnut Latte, we crafted a delicious smooth blend of almond and oat along with flavours of rich hazelnuts, so you can always look forward to enjoying your morning, afternoon or evening treat. Add this STARBUCKS enhancer to hot or iced coffee drinks as a non dairy alternative to creamer or half and half. Simply shake well before use to elevate your cup of coffee!

  • Flavoured coffee enhancer with a smooth blend of almond and oat and added flavours of rich hazelnuts
  • STARBUCKS Almond & Oat Non Dairy Caramel Macchiato Coffee Enhancer (828 ml) is a delightful non dairy alternative to milk, creamer or half-and-half
  • Delicious in hot and cold coffee drinks with a perfectly smooth and balanced taste that pairs well with your favourite STARBUCKS roast
  • Only 30 calories per tablespoon (15 ml)
  • Proudly prepared in Canada with no artificial colours & flavours
results.name: Almond And Oat Non Dairy Hazelnut Latte Coffee Enhancer
